messages:
Meli: Hey design — quick request for an Oct webinar launch 'pocket playbook' bundle: hero slide, printable one-pager, 5 social cards (carousel), a leaderboard, a compact infographic, and a tiny decision flow.
Ash: Can you confirm exact exports & sizes?
Meli: Hero 16:9 (1920x1080), one-pager A4 print @300dpi PDF, socials 1080x1080 x5 (carousel order), leaderboard 1200x628, infographic 640x880 (latency vs cost), decision flow 800x600 SVG. Include SVGs for diagrams and PNG@2x for socials.
Tara: Visual direction? tone/accessibility?
Meli: Brand v2, flat illustrations, warm sunrise accent, navy + teal. High contrast copy for WCAG AA. No photos. Use simple silhouettes if needed.
Design-ops: Note: maintain 16px logo clearspace, provide dark & light logo files, include alt logo placement. I'll attach token set and a short do/don't.
Ash: Content for the sparkline?
Meli: Show batching crossover: cost curve drops, latency creeps up. Annotate with a percent callout like "-35% cost" and a tiny arrow. Minimal gridlines.
Tara: Decision flow — label nodes Hosted / Dedicated and add micro-badges (quantized, fp16, autoscale) with one-line guidance. Badges should be monoline icons.
Meli: Timeline: roughs in 48 hours, final exports 48 hours after copy lock. Prioritize hero + carousel.
Sam-bot: Template link + export checklist uploaded: https://figma.com/file/efgh-pocket-playbook-template
Ash: Scheduling a 20m review 9:30am PT tomorrow to walk roughs. RSVP here.
Meli: Thanks — ping if blocked on brand tokens or access. :sparkles:
